acceptance.requirement: One tenant- and Case-owned canonical Quote aggregate.
acceptance.evidence: tests/integration/commercialQuotes.itest.ts: canonical draft/review/publish keeps one tenant- and Case-owned Quote aggregate.

acceptance.requirement: Unknown price and cost are explicit states and never silently become zero.
acceptance.evidence: tests/integration/commercialQuotes.itest.ts: unknown price blocks publication; unknown cost never becomes a margin. tests/e2e/m2-commercial.mjs asserts a 422 publish block.

acceptance.requirement: Money-safe server totals are identical across registry, builder, client and print.
acceptance.evidence: tests/commercialQuote.test.ts money-safe totals; tests/e2e/m2-commercial.mjs asserts builder total equals the latest immutable Published version.

acceptance.requirement: Package, add-on, replacement and scenario compatibility rules prevent double counting.
acceptance.evidence: tests/commercialQuote.test.ts covers package, add-on, replacement and scenario compatibility.

acceptance.requirement: Catalog and vendor source versions are reproducible.
acceptance.evidence: tests/integration/commercialCatalog.itest.ts: catalog revisions are tenant-scoped, immutable and idempotent.

acceptance.requirement: Legacy commercial data migrates without invented price facts or tenant loss.
acceptance.evidence: Migration rehearsal replays tests/migrations/m2-commercial-fixtures.sql through the M2 migration and passes m2-commercial-assertions.sql.

acceptance.requirement: Draft, review, publish and client decision use guarded canonical transitions.
acceptance.evidence: tests/integration/commercialQuotes.itest.ts drives draft, review, publish and client decision through guarded canonical transitions.

acceptance.requirement: Published QuoteVersion is immutable and remains reproducible after later versions.
acceptance.evidence: tests/integration/commercialQuotes.itest.ts re-reads payload, total and checksum of v1 after publishing v2 and asserts they are unchanged.

acceptance.requirement: Autosave and presentation never mutate or leak a published version.
acceptance.evidence: tests/e2e/m2-commercial.mjs autosaves a v2 draft and asserts the published v1 client link still serves version 1.

acceptance.requirement: Opaque client links are hash-only, expiring, revocable, rate-limited and version-scoped.
acceptance.evidence: tests/integration/commercialQuotes.itest.ts: links are hash-only (raw token never stored), expiring, revocable and version-scoped; concurrent distinct keys leave exactly one active link; the same key replays.

acceptance.requirement: Accept and request-changes decisions are idempotent and audited.
acceptance.evidence: tests/integration/commercialQuotes.itest.ts and tests/e2e/m2-commercial.mjs: accept and request-changes are idempotent and audited.

acceptance.requirement: Expired, revoked and superseded access returns safe honest states.
acceptance.evidence: tests/integration/commercialQuotes.itest.ts asserts EXPIRED, REVOKED and UNAVAILABLE client-view states. A link invalidated by a newer version currently reports REVOKED, because publish revokes the previous version's links before the supersede check runs; the distinct SUPERSEDED client-view state is recorded as an open P2.

acceptance.requirement: Version-bound print/PDF output is stable and accessible.
acceptance.evidence: tests/e2e/m2-commercial.mjs asserts the print action is wired and runs axe on the client view with 0 critical/serious violations.

acceptance.requirement: Tenant, role and client-link boundaries prevent cross-tenant access.
acceptance.evidence: tests/integration/commercialQuotes.itest.ts tenant/role boundaries; tests/e2e/m2-commercial.mjs asserts a foreign organization gets 404.

acceptance.requirement: Failure UX never turns an API error into empty success.
acceptance.evidence: Catalog and quote reads surface API failures instead of an empty catalog; tests/e2e/m2-commercial.mjs fails on any unexpected browser console error.

acceptance.requirement: Desktop, mobile, keyboard and 200 percent zoom gates pass.
acceptance.evidence: tests/e2e/m2-commercial.mjs: desktop, mobile viewport, keyboard-reachable controls and 200 percent zoom overflow checks all pass.

acceptance.requirement: All deterministic gates pass with skipped=0 and NOT_RUN=0.
acceptance.evidence: lint, typecheck, git diff --check (base..HEAD), prisma validate/generate, build, unit 91/91, integration 44/44 at default parallelism, e2e 4/4, migration rehearsal and schema parity: skipped=0, notRun=0. Exact counts are recorded in test-results.json, which is the single source for gate numbers.

acceptance.requirement: Independent review reports P0=0 and P1=0.
acceptance.evidence: Independent adversarial review closed at round 7 with P0=0 and P1=0 on the certified source tree. Seven rounds by seven separate reviewer agents, none given the previous summaries; P1 per round 5, 3, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, all fixed. Round 7's seven P2s are recorded in test-results.json round7AcceptedP2.

acceptance.requirement: Cremation and relative-burial journeys pass on exact isolated Preview SHA.
acceptance.evidence: Both journeys passed on the isolated Preview deployment dpl_3axb1aDPUAEVevmE7ejaysV49UKc at SHA e885135, against Neon store m2-uat-commercial (fingerprint c89bdda845806b40, distinct from production 0257665af2dd90a4): cremation and relative burial PASS, draft/published isolation, client decision, print, manager context, cross-tenant denial, mobile, 200% zoom, accessibility 0 critical / 0 serious, 0 unexpected console errors, skipped 0. Post-UAT: reconciliation 0, orphan commercial rows 0, foreign fixture rows 0.

p1ClosedInCandidate: Unknown price cannot become a definitive economics or budget total.
Margin-only external expenses remain canonical cost without entering client composition.
Builder, economics, immutable history and client view use the same canonical QuoteVersion totals.
Published history and client projection read checksum-verified immutable snapshots instead of current calculator rules.
Canonical read failure or lost route authority hides totals, invalidates stale handles, suppresses stale async feedback and blocks every builder write until a successful canonical retry.
